name: phil/local-pickup
description: Let customers collect orders at a store or convention booth: slots with capacity, ready notices, one-time counter codes with QR, hold periods and expiry.

suggest.phil/commerce-logistics-bundle: To put the goods of an expired pickup back in stock, at the stock location of its pickup point
suggest.phil/commerce-pos-bundle: To hand an order over at a convention booth's register, through the PickupDesk port
suggest.phil/notifications-bundle: To send the ready-for-pickup notice and the arrival notice
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase the collectors' names through PickupPersonalData
suggest.symfony/lock: To book the last place of a slot one customer at a time
suggest.symfony/messenger: To send the ready-for-pickup notice from a worker, with NotifyPickupReadyHandler
